reuseInvestigation.projectImplementation: Reused the existing isolated Taro 4.3.2 audit dependency tree and the existing R01 evidence test. No new dependency or product code was introduced.
reuseInvestigation.adoptionDecision: Not adopted; formal product dependencies and lockfiles were not changed. Remote template/archive execution remains disabled.

advisory.scope: The advisory describes path traversal through a symlink chain. This run reproduced direct ../ traversal, but did not reproduce the advisory's symlink-chain scenario. This is a platform-limited local observation, not a general security proof.

probe.userDataImpactAssessment: No read or write outside the isolated sandbox was confirmed. The symlink-chain case nevertheless resolved an attempted source path outside the sandbox and failed with ENOENT; this run does not prove that arbitrary archive paths cannot probe existing filesystem locations.

decision.nextAction: Keep remote template/archive execution disabled and continue using the local project skeleton. Do not treat this finding as fixed. Any further decompressor testing must use a newly reviewed fixture whose every possible source and destination path remains inside an isolated sandbox.
